caption: The drawing shows a single human figure dressed in an elaborate, full-body costume dominated by shades of red. The costume covers the person from head to toe, including a fitted jumpsuit adorned with numerous small, circular patterns in yellow, green, and blue. The figure wears a matching cape that is also patterned and features segmented gold sections. The headpiece extends upwards and backwards and is shaped with exaggerated facial features, a sharply jutting chin, and a high crest adorned with long red plumes or antennae. The person holds a long, thin white baton in their raised right hand. Brown, pointed shoes are visible on the feet. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements.
title: Marionette
